roadmap.title: Campaign and mission constraints
roadmap.description: Play memory sequences 1 through 13 and the present-day missions on any difficulty, completing all 80 main-mission optional objectives while collecting Mayan Stones and the easy collectibles along the way.

roadmap.title: Open-world cleanup and ship upgrades
roadmap.description: After the campaign, capture the forts, finish every naval contract and tavern, enter all shipwrecks and locations, upgrade the Jackdaw and the Great Inagua hideout, defeat the legendary ships, and finish the combat, hunting, and discovery tasks.

roadmap.title: Freedom Cry DLC
roadmap.description: Play the Freedom Cry campaign as Adewale, complete all 16 optional objectives, and liberate 500 slaves.

roadmap.title: Multiplayer
roadmap.description: Complete the Wolfpack and adversarial multiplayer requirements, using solo Wolfpack to level up and boosting partners for the public-match achievements.

achievements.sortReason: Awarded on completing present day mission 2.

steps.text: Hack the computer for the IT worker, deliver the files to the lobby courier, then return to your workstation.

achievements.sortReason: Awarded on completing present day mission 3.

steps.text: Finish the hacking tasks requested over the radio, hand the data over in the lobby, then re-enter the Animus.

achievements.sortReason: Awarded on completing present day mission 5.

achievements.description: Complete 100% of all main mission constraints.
achievements.sortReason: Requires every main-mission optional objective, so it resolves last in the campaign phase.
achievements.summary: Complete all 80 optional objectives in the main campaign missions.

guide.context: Optional objectives are the extra constraints listed for each memory. A failed one is not permanent: reload the last checkpoint or replay the memory from the progress tracker.

steps.text: Clear the optional objectives of every main memory, reloading the last checkpoint whenever one fails.

achievements.sortReason: Quick tavern activity in Havana during the campaign.
achievements.summary: Wake up in a haystack after passing out from drinking.

steps.text: Buy and drink rum from the bottle on a tavern bar counter five times, until Edward blacks out.
steps.note: Any tavern works; the one in Havana west of the dock is the earliest.

achievements.description: Kill a guard ringing a bell.
achievements.sortReason: Do it at the first plantation alarm bell.
achievements.summary: Kill a guard while he is ringing an alarm bell.

steps.text: Let a guard notice you near an alarm bell, then assassinate him with the @item{Hidden Blade} while he rings it.
steps.note: A sword or pistol kill does not count; the Hidden Blade must land the kill.

achievements.description: Complete every activity in a single location.
achievements.sortReason: Easiest at Cape Bonavista early in the campaign.
achievements.summary: Complete every activity and collectible in a single location.

steps.text: At @loc{Cape Bonavista}, find all 16 chests, the shanty, the 4 @item{Animus fragments}, and the 2 secrets, which include a @item{Mayan Stone} and a treasure map.
steps.note: Small islands and atolls such as @loc{Florida} or @loc{Salt Lagoon} are easier places to finish.

achievements.description: Unlock the secret door in Tulum.
achievements.sortReason: Mayan Stones are gathered throughout the campaign, so it resolves near the end of stage 1.
achievements.summary: Unlock the secret door in the @loc{Tulum} temple by placing the 16 @item{Mayan Stones}.

guide.context: The 16 stones come from the @item{Mayan Stelae} puzzles across the map, and the last stone is only reachable late in the campaign.

steps.text: Solve every @item{Mayan Stelae} puzzle around the map to collect 16 @item{Mayan Stones}.
Place all 16 stones in the locked door inside the @loc{Tulum} temple.

achievements.sortReason: Needs upgraded harpooning first.

guide.context: Killer whales live in the @loc{Conttoyor} waters. Upgrading the rowboat armour, harpoon, and harpoon storage first makes the kill reliable.

steps.text: Sail to @loc{Conttoyor} with the @item{harpoon} upgraded, find a killer whale, and land the harpoon hits until it dies.

achievements.sortReason: Available after sequence 4; earliest Templar Hunt.

guide.context: The four Templar Hunt chains unlock after @loc{memory sequence 4}. Only one is needed, though finishing all four earns the game's best armour.

steps.text: Complete the @loc{Havana} Templar Hunt for @npc{Rhona}, from the Bureau defense to the assassination of @npc{Flint}.

achievements.sortReason: Final contract needs every fort captured.

guide.context: Naval contracts unlock at captured forts. The 15th contract appears at @loc{Fort Serranilla} only after the other 14 are complete.

steps.text: Capture all 11 forts to open every naval contract.
Complete the 14 available contracts, then finish the final contract at @loc{Fort Serranilla}.

achievements.sortReason: Gate for naval contracts; capture before Sea Legs.

steps.text: Sail to each of the 11 @loc{forts}, destroy its defences, and kill its officers and commander.

achievements.sortReason: Unlocks on its own during normal play.

guide.context: There are 100 challenges and normal play completes far more than 25. Do not turn on the cheat codes they unlock, because cheats disable achievements.

steps.text: Keep playing normally; challenges for kills, plunder, and collectibles finish on their own until the 25th is done.

achievements.sortReason: Cumulative income; accrues during play.

guide.context: The total is cumulative and does not have to be held at once. Boarding and plundering ships is the fastest income.

steps.text: Accumulate 50,000 reales by plundering ships, opening chests, and selling cargo.

achievements.sortReason: Accumulates on its own.
achievements.summary: Cover 1 nautical mile of swimming distance in total.

steps.text: Swim around islands and shipwrecks until the total reaches 1 nautical mile, about 1.8 km.

achievements.sortReason: Needs the White Jaguar and Red Howler Monkey materials.

guide.context: The outfit needs a @item{White Jaguar pelt} and a @item{Red Howler Monkey skin}. Either material can also be bought from a general store, for 6,000 and 5,000 reales.

steps.text: Kill and skin the @enemy{White Jaguar} on @loc{Great Inagua} near the end of @loc{memory sequence 4}.
Kill and skin the @enemy{Red Howler Monkey} in the trees on @loc{Isla Providencia}, using @mechanic{Eagle Vision} to spot it.
Craft the @item{Hunter outfit} from both materials.

achievements.sortReason: Accumulates while boarding ships.

steps.text: Board and plunder enemy ships until the total reaches 30.

achievements.sortReason: Hardest naval fights; do after the Jackdaw is upgraded.

guide.context: The four fights sit in the corners of the map and cannot be boarded. Take them on only with a nearly or fully upgraded Jackdaw.

steps.text: Stay behind each ship and use chain shot to stun it, then fire heavy shot, round shot, and mortars.
Defeat @enemy{El Impoluto} far northwest of @loc{Fort Dry Tortuga}.
Defeat @enemy{HMS Prince} in southeastern @loc{Navassa}, southwest of @loc{Mystery Island}.
Defeat @enemy{La Dama Negra} south of @loc{Fort Serranilla}.
steps.note: Only its rear and mortar fire damage its armoured hull.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{HMS Fearless} and @enemy{Royal Sovereign} in @loc{Eleuthera}.
steps.note: Do not sail between the two ships, and weaken both before finishing one off.

achievements.sortReason: Largest material grind; upgrade before the legendary ships.

guide.context: The 68 counted upgrades cover weapons and armour, storage, and harpooning, and cost roughly 315,000 reales, 4,905 metal, 2,750 wood, and 400 cloth. Cosmetic items are not counted. The achievement is reported as buggy, so check the upgrade menu again if it does not pop.

steps.text: Board ships carrying @item{metal}, @item{wood}, and @item{cloth} and stockpile them for the shipwright.

Collect the elite plans from underwater chests and buried treasures; the @item{Elite Fire Barrel Storage} plan is buried at @loc{Isla Providencia} and normally needs the treasure map from the @loc{Kenway's Fleet} Scarlatina mission.
steps.note: If Kenway's Fleet will not load on PC, use a community launcher fix or own the Time Saver Technology pack, which grants every elite plan.

steps.text: Buy the remaining upgrades at a @loc{shipwright} until all 68 upgrades are owned.

achievements.sortReason: Diving Bell routes around the map.

guide.context: Entering each wreck is enough; there is no need to explore or loot it.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Diving Bell} from a harbourmaster for 5,000 reales during @loc{memory sequence 6}.
Use the bell at each of the 10 @loc{shipwrecks} marked around the map.

achievements.sortReason: Eight tavern fights across the map.
achievements.summary: Unlock all 8 taverns by winning their bar fights.

guide.context: The taverns in @loc{Havana}, @loc{Nassau}, and @loc{Great Inagua} do not count. The 8 that do are at Salt Key Bank, Andreas Island, Crooked Island, Ile a Vache, Kingston, Arroyos, Grand Cayman, and Corozal.

steps.text: Talk to the bartender at each of the 8 taverns and win the resulting bar fight.

achievements.sortReason: Crew total accrues while boarding and rescuing.

guide.context: Extra recruits beyond the Jackdaw's capacity still count. Progress is shown in the @loc{Database} under Pirate Statistics.

steps.text: Recruit sailors by plundering ships, hiring in taverns, rescuing castaways, and freeing pirates in towns.
steps.note: Replaying @loc{sequence 3 memory 2} is a reliable way to farm recruits.

achievements.sortReason: Great Inagua hideout purchases, 90,700 reales total.
achievements.summary: Buy all 8 Great Inagua hideout upgrades.

guide.context: The full set costs 90,700 reales: Harbourmaster 500, General Store 700, Tavern 3,500, Campfire 7,000, Brothel 15,000, Manor Facade 6,000, Manor Tower and Garden 18,000, and Manor Guest House 40,000.

steps.text: Buy each of the 8 upgrades at @loc{Great Inagua}, finishing with the 40,000-reale Manor Guest House.

achievements.description: Visit every location of the game.
achievements.sortReason: Every named location including wreck sites.

guide.context: DLC-only locations such as @loc{Black Island} and @loc{Mystery Island} do not count.

steps.text: Discover every location by docking, sailing into it, or entering it with the diving bell.

achievements.sortReason: Enough Level 1 and 2 computers open by present day mission 3.

guide.context: 33 computers become hackable before the present-day story ends; 15 is enough, and enough Level 1 and Level 2 rooms are open after @loc{present day mission 3}.

steps.text: Use the @item{tablet} in the present-day sections to hack computers at the marked icons until 15 are done.

achievements.description: Perform 5 air assassinations from a swinging rope.
achievements.sortReason: Done during campaign boardings.
achievements.summary: Air assassinate 5 enemies from a swinging rope.

guide.context: Ropes hang from the corners of the Jackdaw near the masts during boardings.

steps.text: Line the Jackdaw up so a rope passes over the enemy deck, swing from it, and air-assassinate a target. Repeat across boardings until 5 are done.

achievements.description: Share each type of discovery with friends once.
achievements.sortReason: Random online discoveries; takes the longest to resolve.
achievements.summary: Witness a social chest, a social royal convoy, and a white whale while online.

guide.context: The three discovery types spawn randomly at fixed points and rotate every 6-10 hours; blue map icons mark them and a notification appears when one is found. Nothing has to be shared, but the online discovery service must be connected.

steps.text: Sail and fast travel between locations, checking the map for blue icons, until all three discovery types have appeared.
steps.note: Social chests are the rarest and only appear when you are very close.

achievements.description: Board a ship without losing any crew members.
achievements.sortReason: Likely during natural boarding.
achievements.summary: Capture a ship by boarding it without losing a single crew member.

guide.context: Board a brig or larger; winning only with the swivel gun does not count, so finish the fight on foot.

steps.text: Weaken a @enemy{brig} with the swivel gun, board it, and clear the deck before any of your crew dies.
steps.note: Pistols and rope air assassinations speed up the deck fight.

achievements.description: Rescue pirate hostages by distracting enemies with "dancers."
achievements.sortReason: Convenient during sequence 3 memory 2 in Nassau.
achievements.summary: Rescue pirate hostages by distracting their guards with dancers.

guide.context: Only the save-pirates events where pirates are held prisoner work; events where pirates already fight guards do not count.

steps.text: Hire @npc{dancers} near a pirate-prisoner event, use them to distract the guards, then free the pirates.
steps.note: @loc{Nassau} during @loc{sequence 3 memory 2} has dancers and prisoner events close together.

achievements.description: Kill 4 enemies in a row using multi-pistols.
achievements.sortReason: Needs the fully upgraded pistol holster.
achievements.summary: Kill 4 enemies in a row with the multi-pistol volley.

guide.context: The fully upgraded pistol holster is required for 4 shots, and every shot must be a kill.

steps.text: Gather at least 4 regular soldiers close together, then fire all 4 pistols without manually aiming.
steps.note: @enemy{Brutes} can survive one pistol hit; use regular soldiers or scouts.

achievements.sortReason: First treasure map at Cape Bonavista.

guide.context: Treasure maps give the coordinates of the dig site.

steps.text: Take the treasure map at @loc{Cape Bonavista}, follow it to the flooded cave west of the beach, and dig beside the rock.

achievements.sortReason: 526,000 XP to level 55; the largest time sink

guide.context: Level 55 takes 526,000 XP. The daily 30-minute double XP window and solo Wolfpack runs are the fastest route, and a practiced Wolfpack session takes about 9-12 minutes.

steps.text: Play solo @loc{Wolfpack} on St Mathieu, prioritising the top-left objectives, and use every daily double XP window.
steps.note: Harder Wolfpack difficulties pay roughly 55,000-58,000 points in about 20 minutes.

achievements.description: Finish a game session with an ability set that you customized in Multiplayer.
achievements.sortReason: trivially customized by swapping starting ability slots
achievements.summary: Finish a multiplayer session with a customized ability set.

steps.text: Swap the two starting abilities, @item{Disguise} and @item{Money Bomb}, into different slots, then complete a session.

achievements.description: Complete the Discovery Mode of Wolfpack in Multiplayer.
achievements.sortReason: eight Wolfpack Discovery Mode missions
achievements.summary: Complete all 8 Wolfpack Discovery Mode missions.

guide.context: Discovery Mode doubles as the Wolfpack tutorial.

steps.text: Work through every mission of @loc{Wolfpack Discovery Mode}.

achievements.description: Play and complete a game session of Game Lab in the Multiplayer Public playlist.
achievements.sortReason: public Game Lab session; needs four players
achievements.summary: Complete a Game Lab session in the multiplayer public playlist.

guide.context: Public matchmaking needs at least 4 players, so arrange boosting partners; winning is not required.

steps.text: Join @loc{Game Lab} from the public playlist and finish the match.

achievements.description: Play on every game mode, and use every ability and ranged weapon once in Multiplayer.
achievements.sortReason: all modes plus every ability and ranged weapon; needs level 48
achievements.summary: Play all 8 multiplayer modes and use each ability and ranged weapon at least once.

guide.context: Buying all 15 abilities and 5 ranged weapons needs at least level 48 and 10,230 Animus credits. @item{Bodyguard} only counts when used against another player while being chased (Deathmatch or Wanted); the rest work on Wolfpack enemies.

steps.text: Complete one session on each multiplayer mode: Wolfpack, Wolfpack Discovery Mode, Manhunt, Artifact Assault, Domination, Wanted, Deathmatch, and Assassinate.
Get all 15 abilities and 5 ranged weapons and use each one at least once, including @item{Bodyguard} while being chased.

achievements.description: Playing as The Jaguar, be the highest scoring player of a Domination game session.
achievements.sortReason: highest score in a won Domination session as The Jaguar
achievements.summary: As @npc{The Jaguar}, win a Domination session with the highest score.

guide.context: Kills and stuns score more than simply holding points, so play aggressively while keeping at least one point captured.

steps.text: Select @npc{The Jaguar} in @loc{Domination}, hold points while scoring kills, and win the match with the top score.

achievements.description: Playing as Blackbeard, perform an acrobatic kill and a gun kill in less than 10 seconds.
achievements.sortReason: Wolfpack acrobatic and pistol kills in one window; pistol needs level 38
achievements.summary: As @npc{Blackbeard}, land an acrobatic kill and a pistol kill within 10 seconds of each other.

guide.context: The pistol unlocks at level 38. An acrobatic kill is made while hanging from a ledge or crouched on a high spot.

steps.text: In @loc{Wolfpack}, wait for the first chest wave to spread the enemies out, acrobatic-kill the near enemy, then pistol-kill the far one.

achievements.description: Playing as The Orchid, block 10 abilities from opponents with Sabotage.
achievements.sortReason: ten Sabotage blocks as The Orchid; needs level 28
achievements.summary: As @npc{The Orchid}, block 10 opponent abilities with @item{Sabotage}.

guide.context: Sabotage is a ranged weapon unlocked at level 28. A successful block makes a faint ringing sound.

steps.text: Equip @item{Sabotage} as @npc{The Orchid} and hit an enemy just before they use their ability, ten times.
steps.note: Thieves before they turn invisible and Brutes before they use Wipe are reliable targets.

achievements.description: Kill a player using a lift that has been trapped with Booby Trap.
achievements.sortReason: public match Booby Trap lift kill; needs level 26
achievements.summary: Kill a player with a pulley lift trapped by Booby Trap.

guide.context: Booby Trap unlocks at level 26, and the kill must happen in a public match rather than a private one.

steps.text: Trap a pulley lift with @item{Booby Trap}, then bait another player into riding it.

achievements.sortReason: Awarded in the second Freedom Cry memory.
achievements.summary: Free your first slave in Freedom Cry.

steps.text: In the second Freedom Cry memory, kill the @enemy{Overseer} chasing a slave and free the slave.

achievements.sortReason: Liberation total; slave ships after the fourth memory.

guide.context: Plantations free 30-40 slaves each; after the fourth memory, slave ships free 90 or more and are much faster, though some have strong escorts.

steps.text: Raid plantations and board slave ships around @loc{Port-au-Prince} until 500 slaves are freed.

achievements.description: Kill 5 guards at once with a blunderbuss.
achievements.sortReason: Blunderbuss granted after the third memory.
achievements.summary: In Freedom Cry, kill 5 guards in one blunderbuss shot.

guide.context: The blunderbuss is granted after the third Freedom Cry memory.

steps.text: Group at least 5 guards together, then fire the @item{blunderbuss} into the cluster.
steps.note: The gate guards in the final mission stand in a tight group.

achievements.description: Disarm the Gouverneur and kill him with the branding iron.
achievements.sortReason: Final memory; also a side objective.
achievements.summary: In Freedom Cry, disarm the Gouverneur and finish him with the branding iron.

guide.context: This is also a side objective in the final memory and is required for His Full Attention.

steps.text: Approach the @npc{Gouverneur} unarmed, counter his swing to take the @item{branding iron}, then kill him with it.
steps.note: Clear the nearby guards first; if he flees, chase him down before he can drop the branding iron.

achievements.sortReason: Completing the nine Freedom Cry memories.

steps.text: Finish all nine memories of the @loc{Freedom Cry} campaign.

achievements.sortReason: All 16 Freedom Cry optional objectives.
achievements.summary: Complete all 16 Freedom Cry optional objectives.

guide.context: The final memory counts only after the credits finish rolling.

steps.text: Clear every optional objective in the nine Freedom Cry memories, reloading a checkpoint when one fails.
